findings.summary: Computed CSS has no prefers-color-scheme or color-scheme support; the dark surface is fixed rather than following the user preference.
findings.evidence: Computed CSS has no prefers-color-scheme or color-scheme support; the dark surface is fixed rather than following the user preference.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven tokens so light and dark preferences both receive an intentional scheme.

findings.summary: CSS inspection found no prefers-reduced-motion rule while transition and advertising animation rules remain active.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-reduced-motion rule while transition and advertising animation rules remain active.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential transitions and animations in prefers-reduced-motion and disable or shorten them when reduce is requested.

findings.summary: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors adaptation, so custom icon and control styling has no explicit high-contrast fallback.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors adaptation, so custom icon and control styling has no explicit high-contrast fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles that retain visible text, focus indicators, controls, and scrollbars.

findings.summary: Representative page and route changes are immediate full-document swaps; CSS inspection found no view-transition usage.
findings.evidence: Representative page and route changes are immediate full-document swaps; CSS inspection found no view-transition usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with reduced-motion respected.

findings.summary: The 32,105px mobile home page keeps static chrome and exposes no progress or scroll-state response.
findings.evidence: The 32,105px mobile home page keeps static chrome and exposes no progress or scroll-state response.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or scroll-state-aware compact header for this unusually long listing.

findings.summary: In-page and route navigation provides no focus/highlight or directional transition cue; CSS has no highlight, marker, or view-transition support.
findings.evidence: In-page and route navigation provides no focus/highlight or directional transition cue; CSS has no highlight, marker, or view-transition support.
findings.suggestedFix: Move focus to the destination heading and add a restrained highlight/transition cue after navigation.

findings.summary: The site exposes a custom menu and many scripted buttons, but the DOM contains no dialog, details, or popover primitives.
findings.evidence: The site exposes a custom menu and many scripted buttons, but the DOM contains no dialog, details, or popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the menu with a semantic disclosure/popover pattern, declarative dismissal, and correct focus handling.

findings.summary: Layout adapts through viewport media queries only; CSS inspection found no @container despite cards being reused in several grid contexts.
findings.evidence: Layout adapts through viewport media queries only; CSS inspection found no @container despite cards being reused in several grid contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card grids containment and component-level queries while keeping the current viewport fallback.

findings.summary: The focused logo link computed to outline:none and box-shadow:none; 16 visible interactive targets were under 24px, and Lighthouse failed target-size.
findings.evidence: The focused logo link computed to outline:none and box-shadow:none; 16 visible interactive targets were under 24px, and Lighthouse failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styling and enlarge or space pointer targets to at least the WCAG minimum, preferably 44px for primary controls.

findings.summary: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 8.0s and FCP 3.2s, although the desktop trace measured LCP 1.47s and TBT 25.61ms.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 8.0s and FCP 3.2s, although the desktop trace measured LCP 1.47s and TBT 25.61ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the mobile LCP image, reduce initial image competition, and verify field/mobile LCP after deployment.

findings.summary: HAR recorded 117 requests and 1.66MB transferred; 88 below-fold images were eager, and parser-inserted stylesheets/scripts form the critical chain.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 117 requests and 1.66MB transferred; 88 below-fold images were eager, and parser-inserted stylesheets/scripts form the critical chain.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold images, reserve the first images for high priority, and defer non-critical scripts/styles.

findings.summary: The load includes a 90KB Yandex script, a 37KB polyfilled player bundle, advertising endpoints, and 97 image requests before user interaction.
findings.evidence: The load includes a 90KB Yandex script, a 37KB polyfilled player bundle, advertising endpoints, and 97 image requests before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally load the player and analytics, remove unnecessary polyfills for the support policy, and defer advertising code until appropriate consent/interaction.

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed button-name, link-name, image-alt, and frame-title; the probe found 9 images without alt, 10 empty links, and one unlabelled input.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, link-name, image-alt, and frame-title; the probe found 9 images without alt, 10 empty links, and one unlabelled input.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide names for icon controls and frames, label the input, and add meaningful or empty alt text as appropriate.

findings.summary: No main/nav/header/footer landmarks were present, the home page starts at h3 with no h1, and keyboard focus had no visible indicator.
findings.evidence: No main/nav/header/footer landmarks were present, the home page starts at h3 with no h1, and keyboard focus had no visible indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic landmarks and an h1-led hierarchy, then ensure every focusable control has a visible :focus-visible state.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow has no overflow, but Lighthouse failed target-size and frame-title; the probe found 16 undersized interactive targets.
findings.evidence: Mobile reflow has no overflow, but Lighthouse failed target-size and frame-title; the probe found 16 undersized interactive targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the good reflow while enlarging targets and supplying accessible titles/equivalents for embedded media.

findings.summary: The live DOM is standards mode with a doctype, but all 94 images lack width/height attributes and 93 lack responsive sources.
findings.evidence: The live DOM is standards mode with a doctype, but all 94 images lack width/height attributes and 93 lack responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic image dimensions and responsive srcset/sizes while retaining modern WebP delivery.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reported DevTools inspector issues and third-party-cookie problems, indicating unresolved browser platform warnings.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported DevTools inspector issues and third-party-cookie problems, indicating unresolved browser platform warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve all DevTools Issues, remove stale/problematic integrations, and retest BFCache and deprecation diagnostics.

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; recon found javascript: links even though viewport and robots configuration are present.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; recon found javascript: links even though viewport and robots configuration are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace javascript: pseudo-links with buttons for actions or real href URLs for navigation, with descriptive text.

findings.summary: The page has a 200 response, canonical URL, and permissive robots.txt, but /sitemap.xml returned no readable URL set and no hreflang is exposed.
findings.evidence: The page has a 200 response, canonical URL, and permissive robots.txt, but /sitemap.xml returned no readable URL set and no hreflang is exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid sitemap and align it with canonical/robots signals; add hreflang if localized variants are intended.

findings.summary: The media home page exposes zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing a rich media catalogue.
findings.evidence: The media home page exposes zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing a rich media catalogue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter metadata and schema.org WebSite/VideoObject JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent; two cookies are not Secure and all seven use SameSite=None.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are all absent; two cookies are not Secure and all seven use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, a tested CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; tighten cookie Secure/SameSite settings.

findings.summary: The page contacted 10 third-party origins on load, including Yandex and multiple advertising/tracking domains, and set long-lived analytics cookies without an evident consent choice.
findings.evidence: The page contacted 10 third-party origins on load, including Yandex and multiple advertising/tracking domains, and set long-lived analytics cookies without an evident consent choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory and minimise third parties, gate non-essential analytics/advertising behind valid consent, and shorten identifiers.

findings.summary: Headers evidence found no HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add browser-enforced defensive headers and roll out CSP in report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.summary: The Russian page has an empty html lang and dir, no hreflang, and CSS inspection found no logical properties.
findings.evidence: The Russian page has an empty html lang and dir, no hreflang, and CSS inspection found no logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang=ru, use dir-aware logical CSS properties, and declare localized alternates where they exist.

findings.summary: Non-essential analytics and advertising requests and identifiers start on initial load with no visible consent or privacy choice in the captured first viewport.
findings.evidence: Non-essential analytics and advertising requests and identifiers start on initial load with no visible consent or privacy choice in the captured first viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Present an honest, equally weighted privacy choice and prevent non-essential tracking before consent.

findings.summary: Of 94 images, 88 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded, 93 lacked srcset, and every image lacked intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: Of 94 images, 88 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded, 93 lacked srcset, and every image lacked intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add loading=lazy below the fold, responsive srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions, and retain modern formats.

findings.summary: The initial page fetched 97 images and contacted 10 third-party origins before the user requested media playback.
findings.evidence: The initial page fetched 97 images and contacted 10 third-party origins before the user requested media playback.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop eager below-fold fetches and defer analytics, advertising, and player work until needed and permitted.

findings.summary: Third-party analytics/advertising plus 97 image requests account for a substantial share of the 117-request, 1.66MB initial load.
findings.evidence: Third-party analytics/advertising plus 97 image requests account for a substantial share of the 117-request, 1.66MB initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a route budget, defer third parties, and request only media visible or imminently needed.

findings.summary: The static listing retained about 10.1MB across roughly 187k heap nodes, a high DOM-related footprint for a catalogue landing page.
findings.evidence: The static listing retained about 10.1MB across roughly 187k heap nodes, a high DOM-related footprint for a catalogue landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the initial card/DOM count through pagination or content-visibility and load only the visible catalogue window.
